title: The Business That Published Its Process
short_teaser: Showing how work is done can build confidence by making quality visible.
story: Showing how work is done can build confidence by making quality visible. Transparency can become part of the offer. Strong businesses create value people can understand and trust through the decisions beneath the visible offer. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Transparency can become part of the offer. Strong businesses create value people can understand and trust through the decisions beneath the visible offer.
spark_application: Apply the lesson to one customer, offer, process, or decision. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
